name: library-cue
style: Instrumental 1970s London production-library jazz-funk, 98 BPM, a cheeky caper theme for a Saturday-teatime telly thriller. Tight crisp breakbeat, rubbery fuzz bass line, clavinet and wah guitar chattering, Hammond organ swells, punchy trumpet and trombone fanfare with a flute answer. The groove thins to bass and hi-hat in places so a narrator can talk on top. Mid-cue a dramatic suspense stab: low brass cluster, timpani roll, trembling strings, then near silence. Recovers into a sunny major-key lift, horns and organ climbing to a jaunty closing flourish and one tight final chord. Dry 1970s studio, warm tape
exclude: vocals, singing, choir, rap, lyrics, humming, vocal chops, trap hi-hats, EDM, synthwave, epic orchestral trailer, lo-fi, fade out
